output.summary: The evidence points mainly to the venue move, not programming, as the driver of the ticket decline. Single-ticket sales fell 45% right after the move to Brightwater, and the downtown cathedral concerts sold about 48% more tickets per concert with similar pricing. Post-1945 repertoire shows no ticket difference in the Brightwater concert data, and the peer orchestras that stayed put lost a similar share. The core subscriber base is renewing at a steady 85-86%. Non-renewal of the music director would risk the $400,000-per-season key-person grant and the commission-linked New Works grant, so it looks harmful. A segmented analysis before December is the preferred step. Marketing effectiveness remains unknown because no attribution data exists.
